newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait investment firm sheds stake in subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait investment firm sheds stake in subsidiary.

text.p: Kuwait Investment Projects Co (KIPCO) has sold 100 million United Industries Co (UIC) shares for 25 million dinars, the Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) said on Wednesday.
"KIPCO has reached an arrangement through which is sold 100 million UIC shares at 250 fils per share," a KSE statement said. There are 1,000 fils to the dinar.
KIPCO "made a net profit of about eight million dinars from the sale," it said. The buyer was a client of KIPCO's which runs investment portfolios for private investors, said the statement.
KIPCO along with sister firms hold a majority stake at UIC which has 800 million subscribed shares. Their stake in March was estimated at about 90 percent.
UIC's share closed at 240 fils on Wednesday and that of KIPCO finished at 285 fils.
UIC made a net profit of 584,000 dinars in 1996 compared to 1.86 million in 1995, KSE figures show.
